data.narrative:
AAVantgarde Bio, a Series B biotech company founded by Alberto Auricchio and Natalia Misciattelli, has raised $141M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 8 private biotech peers and 3 public sector comps (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L), with private peers including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B).

Two triangulation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.9x step-up multiplier from Series B to the next stage, implies a valuation of $268M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics at Series B) to $10.3B (Colossal). Public-comp anchoring using the 8.1x price-to-sales median for listed biotech peers could not be applied due to AAVantgarde's undisclosed revenue.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $228M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median implied value of $1.9B. The wide dispersion reflects significant stage and maturity differences within the peer set, particularly the valuation gap between Series B (Eikon at $539M) and Series C peers. Key uncertainties include AAVantgarde's clinical-stage advancement, IP strength, and capital efficiency relative to peers.
